watches.name: Supa Diver Bronze Green Monster Limited Edition
watches.description: SUPA Diver Bronze’s double-layered dial is filled lavishly with Swiss Super-LumiNova C3 or BGW9 on its chapter ring, applied hour indexes and candlestick hands which emit strong glowing lume. Powered by Swiss-made Sellita, SW200-1 automatic movement with date window at 6. The 44mm angular bronze case is fitted with a domed sapphire crystal with triple layer of anti-reflective and anti-fingerprint coating. The 120 clicks uni-directional bronze bezel blends in superbly well with the matt black ceramic insert. It has a water resistant up to 300 meters or 1000 feet, making it a worthy companion on your deep sea dives. The textured design rubber strap that it paired with gives the watch a contemporary look and wears comfortably on your wrist. watches.name: Ascent Skull Black Limited Edition Automatic
watches.description: ASCENT Skull is our modern interpretation of super compressor (SC) style design automatic watch featuring dual crowns with an internal rotating bezel. The history of SC diver watches can be traced back from the late 1950s to the early 1970s. The crown at 4 o’clock is used to wind the movement and set time. The crown at 2 o’clock is used to rotate the internal bezel operates by a little star gear for timing a dive. Unlike typical dive watches, the Ascent has a modern sleek look baring an iconic design with lots of history behind it. The ASCENT Skull Limited Edition to 300 pieces. One of the most common symbolic use of the skull design is as a representation of death and mortality. The ASCENT Skull incorporates a menacing skull design with a layered dial exposing its rotating escape wheel, part of the mechanical movement through its mouth. The Ascent Skull serves as a constant reminder that time is precious, one should seize every second in their life and live life to the fullest. Case Design: Custom-Made Case Case Material: 316L Stainless Stain (IP Plating with Matt-Black) Case Back: Screwed Down Embossed with Individually Numbered (limited to 150 pieces) Case Diameter: 42mm Height: 13.5mm Lug Width: 22mm Dial: Open-Heart Layered Skull Dial Bezel: Bi-directional Rotating Bezel Date: With Date Function Index & Hands: Applied Index (BGW9 Luminous) Crystal: Scratch Resistant Sapphire with Anti-Reflective Coating Crown: Screwed Down Movement: Automatic 82S0 (Miyota) Water Resistance: 200m / 600ft Straps: Top Grain Calf Leather
